answer: Flag the edges a sybil cluster depends on by their betweenness. In an honest graph trust flows along many redundant routes, but a manufactured cluster reaches the network only through a few bridge edges nearly every honest-to-fake path must cross — outsized betweenness, a nadir of connectivity on the horizon between real and fake. Score identities down when their path to the seeds funnels through such high-betweenness choke edges rather than a broad trellis of independent links. A soft signal feeding the hard non-kin quorum and bond gates, never a payout.
